name: Rust player access
description: Public means any authenticated Steam player, not anonymous Steam authentication.

spec.question_description: Restricted uses the vanilla skip-queue method for up to five approved friends.
Required for restricted mode: one to five numeric IDs or numeric profile URLs, separated by lines or commas. Resolve vanity links first. Leave blank for public mode.

Full Rust owner/admin rights. Enter numeric Steam IDs, separated by commas or lines. Restricted-mode admins must also be approved players. preserve retains current admins; blank revokes all game admins.
